description: This file contains unit tests for the LicenseDao class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It tests CRUD operations and license name existence checks to ensure the LicenseDao behaves correctly.

classes.name: LicenseDaoTest
classes.description: A test suite for verifying LicenseDao functionalities including adding, editing, retrieving, deleting, and checking license names in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes LicenseDao instance and populates test data before each test case.

methods.name: testAddLicense
methods.description: Tests adding a new License and verifies the stored name.

methods.name: testEditLicense
methods.description: Tests editing an existing License record and verifies the updated name.

methods.name: testGetLicenseById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a License by its ID and verifies the license's name.

methods.name: testGetLicenseList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of Licenses and verifies the count and type.

methods.name: testDeleteLicenses
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple licenses by IDs and verifies the number of deleted records.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deleting non-existing license IDs and expects zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if different case and whitespace variations of license names are recognized as existing.

methods.name: testGetLicenseByName
methods.description: Tests fetching licenses by name with different case and whitespace, asserting correct record retrieval or absence.
